verbatim_locators.source_fulltext_indexed_evidence: Europe PMC JATS XML fingerprinted; all six figure rasters, the typeset article PDF and the supplementary PDF retrieved from the PMC open-access S3 mirror. The PMC figure rasters are 550 px wide and illegible at panel level, so every panel reading below is taken from images extracted out of the article PDF at 1500-1750 px. The supplementary PDF's five pages were read in full and its four embedded figure images extracted and inspected.
verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: No locator is abstract-anchored, and one entry exists precisely because the abstract and the Results disagree.

entries.proposition: THE ABSTRACT'S HUMAN CLAIM IS NOT WHAT THE RESULTS REPORT. The abstract says filter retardation showed TPC6A-delta aggregation 'preceding' amyloid-beta generation in middle-aged normal hippocampi; the Results report no difference between controls and Alzheimer cases for this protein.
entries.snippet: No significant difference was shown in TPC6A or TIAF1 aggregation
entries.anchor: Figure 3 legend / Results, 'Aggregation of TPC6A and TIAF1 in nondemented human hippocampi'

entries.proposition: FIGURE ATTESTATION. Figure 3A is the panel behind the sentence above and it adjudicates: the TPC6A bars carry p = 0.942 and the TIAF1 bars p = 0.850, while p-WWOX (p = 0.036), NFT (p = 0.014) and amyloid-beta (p = 0.003) do separate. The null is therefore not a power failure of the assay: the same blot separates three other analytes on the same samples.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 3A bar chart '% Protein aggregation in hippocampus', C vs AD pairs: TPC6A p=0.942, TIAF1 p=0.850, p-WWOX p=0.036, NFT p=0.014, Abeta p=0.003.
entries.anchor: Figure 3A, image extracted from page 5 of the article PDF at 1750 px width

entries.proposition: The human filter-retardation result that the abstract reports was obtained with the pan-specific antibody, which by the paper's own Methods cannot distinguish wild-type TPC6A from the delta isoform. So no human measurement in this paper is isoform-resolved.
entries.snippet: Western blotting was then carried out using specific antibodies for TPC6A (pan-specific)

entries.proposition: Antibody validation for all four homemade antisera is peptide blocking only. No genetic null, no knockdown and no pre-immune serum control is reported for them.
entries.snippet: Specificity of the antisera was tested using the synthetic peptides to block immunostaining
entries.anchor: Methods, 'Antibodies and antibody production in rabbits'

entries.proposition: THE EARLIER PARTIAL READING COULD NOT SEE THIS, AND IT MATTERS. The pT181-tau claim - the only tau datum in a young WWOX-null brain anywhere in this corpus - is a count of aggregates in whole brain-hemisphere sections, n = 5, p = 0.0176, with heterozygous animals included and indistinguishable from wild type. It is a stereological-style count, not a biochemical measurement of tau phosphorylation.
entries.snippet: pT181-Tau aggregates were significantly increased in the brain hemisphere sections
entries.anchor: Results, 'Wwox gene ablation induces TPC6A-delta and tau aggregation in the brain of 3-week-old knockout mice'

entries.proposition: FIGURE ATTESTATION qualifying the sentence above. Figure 5D shows three photomicrographs (two Wwox-/-, one Wwox+/+) and one bar chart with three genotype bars: +/+ about 11, -/+ about 6, -/- about 26 aggregates, error bars that overlap between +/+ and -/-, and a single bracket labelled p = 0.0176 drawn from +/+ to -/-. The heterozygote mean is BELOW wild type, so this panel carries no dose-dependence and the brief's reading of it as a graded genotype effect is not supported.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 5D 'pT181-Tau': three micrographs labelled Wwox -/-, Wwox -/-, Wwox +/+; bar chart '# of pT181 Tau aggregates' with bars +/+ ~11, -/+ ~6, -/- ~26 and a bracket p = 0.0176 spanning +/+ to -/-.
entries.anchor: Figure 5D, image extracted from page 7 of the article PDF at 1500 px width
entries.qualifies_needle: aggregates were significantly increased in the brain hemisphere sections

entries.proposition: The Wwox-null mouse used here is a whole-body constitutive knockout that dies at about a month, so every phenotype it carries is read at a developmental stage no human WWOX-DEE genotype class can be compared with directly, and against a survival ceiling that bounds any latency statement made from it.
entries.snippet: The mice can only survive for about a month
entries.anchor: Results, 'Wwox gene ablation induces TPC6A-delta and tau aggregation in the brain of 3-week-old knockout mice'

entries.proposition: SUPPLEMENT-VERSUS-METHODS CONTRADICTION found only by reading the supplementary PDF. The Methods name the pan-specific peptide as residues 84-100 and the second phosphosite as Tyr112; Supplementary Figure 1 names the same peptide as residues 70-86 and the site as Tyr116. The peptide sequence is identical in both, so the numbering - not the reagent - is inconsistent.
entries.snippet: amino acid #84–100 for pan-specific antibody production
